basis: Manual semantic review of all nine generated bindings plus deterministic CI output. No model/runtime execution.

findings.finding: The authorized configuration contains input-label to dotted-path mappings, but the runtime-visible configuration does not explicitly define path-resolution semantics. A model could treat frozen placeholders as unresolved even though the binder resolved them deterministically.
findings.required_change: Add explicit binding semantics to block 2: source roots, path-resolution rule, fail-closed unresolved rule, and statement that resolved task values remain data rather than instructions.

findings.finding: The configured OBJECTIVE_MET threshold references five supplied classification examples, but the task instance contains no five examples. Runtime evaluation would therefore require invention or remain under-specified.
findings.required_change: Supply exactly five low-risk deterministic-vs-behavioral test examples in task data; do not ask the runtime to invent the assessment corpus.

findings.finding: The optimization task describes a baseline and asks for a content reduction while not supplying the actual baseline artifact. This makes READY versus DIAGNOSE_FIRST/READY_WITH_UNKNOWNS unnecessarily ambiguous.
findings.required_change: Supply a concrete baseline artifact and use measurable preservation/repetition metrics that can be checked against that artifact.

findings.finding: Prepared invocations have cross-cutting behavioral assertions but no out-of-band expected state set. A canary could choose an architecturally wrong state while still appearing superficially useful.
findings.required_change: Add evaluation-only expected_state_set metadata outside the three runtime blocks. It must never be included in model input.

next_gate: Build successor binding/invocation pilot v1.2, regress all four findings, rerun deterministic CI, then manually inspect exact packets again.
